cases.detail: All six permutations: 3 conflicting origins, no C02 patch or snapshot write.
Three equal imports collapse to one semantic update and retain all origins.
Missing Issue, bad timestamp, same-time flag, missing/skip/held Projects are nonterminal; empty control converges.
A later context heartbeat advances graph revision but cannot win content timestamp comparison.
Shared primitive maintains replace/create-only contracts; three callers keep immutable existing bytes.
Receipt link failure restores all paths and bytes while preserving nested preexisting state.
Direct-tool aliases and containing directory mutations share protected authority; nested noncanonical fixtures and scratch pass.
Separated answer accumulation -> first confirm candidate passes; missing last block item changes neither input nor existing output.
Foreign local registry through alias excludes real cache path; valid shared user registration restores it.
Literal env quote/newline/dollar survives shell; working-directory expression skips only when effective.
Only actual schema value span is exempt; adjacent command and code comment remain detected.
Two caller roots stay independent and missing resolver cannot inherit a previous successful module.
9 exact current manifest commands succeed with both roots containing spaces and stop on resolver exit2; builder prefix also stops.
All canonical stored install obligations reject component attribution, current and legacy; unrelated component P13 task passes.
